entities.summary: Mohammad Karami is a Brigadier General of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps who has served as the Commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Ground Forces since June 2025. He has also served as the Commander of the Guards Officer of Imam Hossein University since November 2024. Karami served as the Governor of Sistan and Baluchestan in the Government of Ebrahim Raisi.
